note: A synthetic client (Slice 129 worked example). Not a real company.
problem: Our on-time delivery rate to stores fell from 95% to 86% last quarter.

answers.common.decision: Where to fix delivery performance first; the head of logistics decides.
answers.common.deadline: The logistics review at the end of next month.
answers.common.audience: The head of logistics and the warehouse manager.
answers.common.materials: We made 20,000 deliveries to stores last quarter. Of the late deliveries, 2,100 left our main warehouse late. Each late delivery costs us $45 in re-delivery and store penalties.
answers.data-analytics.data: Delivery records with planned and actual times, and warehouse dispatch logs.
answers.data-analytics.question: Why on-time delivery fell and where the late deliveries start.
